responsibility: Defines the ISO mathematical interface for SHORTCOMPLEX values, including constants, magnitude/phase/conjugation, transcendental functions, polar construction, scalar multiplication, and the module-specific exception-status query. It is the short-precision complex companion to ComplexMath and LongComplexMath in the gm2 ISO numeric library.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the interface half of the ShortComplexMath pair: it declares the SHORTCOMPLEX constants and mathematical API visible to users, while ShortComplexMath.mod maps those operations onto cbuiltin float-complex intrinsics.
